description: Turn the material point plot scale on or off. Not in the 9.8 manual; `mpoint plot-scale on` on MPoint3D 9.8.54 answers 'Material point plot scale activated', and the only tokens accepted are on/off.
notes: Live-discovered on MPoint3D 9.7 (2026-09-14): 'mpoint ?' enumerates it, but it has no page in the MPM doc tree and no entry in the installed command index (out_commands.txt).

Semantics are NOT established beyond the on/off switch. On 9.7 the command took no arguments; on MPoint3D 9.8.54 `mpoint plot-scale ?` accepts only on/off and `mpoint plot-scale on` answers 'Material point plot scale activated'. What the scale changes in the plot is not documented.
'mpoint plot-scale 2.0' is rejected, so it does not take the scale factor the name suggests. (syntax)
